text:
sarah: heads up — main turned red immediately after merging PR #3456 (feature/kv-cache). Buildkite link: https://buildkite.company/teams/redwood/pipelines/main/builds/8765. Failing job: integration/gpu_inference_ci. Can someone grab this?
ci-bot: build 8765 failed: job integration/gpu_inference_ci (agent gpu-12). Failed test: tests/e2e/transformer_inference_test.py::test_kv_cache_consistency. Error snippet: ```RuntimeError: KV cache mismatch at step 12
  expected: [0.12, -0.34, ...]
  got: [0.15, -0.33, ...]
```
mike: pinging @olivia and @jordan — last deploy from that PR was sarah's change to kv cache batching. @olivia does that ring any alarm bells? :eyes:
olivia: saw the deploy. I own the kv cache refactor area. I'll take a quick look. Can someone rerun the job first to rule out flake?
jordan: +1 to rerun, but if it's deterministic we should bisect between main before merge and the merge commit. sarah can you paste the commit sha that merged?
sarah: merged at sha `a1b2c3d4`. The PR touched `runtime/kv_cache.py` and `serving/batching.py`. Rerun command (buildkite): ```buildkite-agent build cancel 8765 && buildkite-agent build 8766 --hook``` — or just rerun the job from UI.
mike: I kicked a re-run for the pipeline job (ID 8766). build queued. If it fails again, @olivia can request a bisect. Also adding the label `ci:red` on the PR to alert owners. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: build 8766 started (queued on gpu-14).
olivia: thanks — if 8766 fails, I'll run a local reproducer against the merged commit and then start git bisect across the last 5 commits touching runtime/kv_cache.py. Will report findings here. If anyone has a quick reproducer script, drop it now.
jordan: FYI I saw similar flaky kv cache mismatches in an older run; sometimes quantization scheduling changes order of ops on CUDA. If it reproduces, check quantization hooks in serving/batching.py.
sarah: noted. I'll drop logs from the failed agent once 8766 finishes. For now marking this as urgent on the incident board.
